D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that Public Safety is co­hosting the annual firearm
buyback event on June 25.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Director, announced that the Carson Street Beautification Project
received an award from CMAA; and that a tire recycling event and block clean­up will be held on June
27.

Councilmember Farfan asked about the tire recycling event.

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, reported that she’s working on public outreach for
fireworks season.

Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, provided an update on the Summer YEP Program.

There were no City Attorney Reports.
